description: Listen for the person's next spoken reply to the open coach. While the person's Talk switch on the coach view is on, each time they pause at the end of a thought the view sends what they said to the coach, not into this chat. This waits up to wait_seconds for it and answers what they said (status heard, with the message number), or that they said nothing yet (status silent). When it hears them: at once, in the same step, call coach_say with an acknowledgment spoken with the nod: thank them, say aloud that you understood, and say what you are about to do, then, while the service runs, chat with them about the process and about how their answers are affirming, in a motivational voice (reply_to set to the message number, with a head nod cue), and call the GoldSeam service the request needs; when the service answers, call coach_say with the answer and coach_board with its key points or a picture when they help; then call coach_listen again, for as long as they talk with the coach; stop when they type in the chat instead. Use the coach_id and coach.seat open_coach returned.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the person to speak (the most when omitted; 0 only looks)

name: coach_listen

heard.description: from, message (its number, for coach_say's reply_to) and text: what the person said

title: Coach Listen
